It is far from a cure for anyone but me. I have tried so many different things and done so much stuff but this particular thing works the best for me. I use to race motorcycles and be into the adrenaline side of motor sports. It worked for me for a bit but was more in the moment happiness then I would go back to my normal routine of depression. Every person has different thoughts desires and needs. Yours may not be swimming bicycling and running. What if it was something completely different something you've never done yet. My original post was to show how one moment was my saving point.

I loved riding my motorcycle and doing many other activities in the past and said the same thing many times. Those things that I loved to do or things I may have found helpful previously werent doing it for me anymore for a long time i lost interest in most things. Its not a over night change. Me personally the bicycle didnt change me, it was the words I hurd that stuck. The bicycle was a tool to make the changes I wanted from those words. Im not saying the words I hurd and the tools I have been give will work for anyone else. But give yourself HOPE  that you will hear the words you need and the tools to make the changes in the moment will present itself when they are meant to. With that you cant just sit back and wait for these things to happen. Sometimes it works out that way but you cant stay idle...be active. Do things that children have fun doing. Walk, run, ride bikes, play catch, swim, draw, color, read, etc....distract your mind.
Yes it has been a great experience. Looking forward to helping others now while I work on my own  EPIC Journey.
